reset-after-por.title: Reset after power-on
reset-after-por.quote: Issue the reset after tPOR or after the VCAP1 voltage is greater than 1.1 V, whichever time is longer.

tSCCS.title: CS high after the last SCLK
tSCCS.quote: tSCCS: Delay time, final SCLK falling edge to CS high: 4 tCLK minimum.

tCSH.title: CS high time
tCSH.quote: tCSH: Pulse duration, CS high: 2 tCLK minimum.

tSDECODE.title: Gap between command bytes
tSDECODE.quote: When sending multi-byte commands (such as RREG or WREG), a 4 tCLK period must separate the end of one byte (or command) and the next.

start-pin-low.title: START command with the START pin low
start-pin-low.quote: When the START command is sent to the device, keep the START pin low until the STOP command is issued.

rdatac-only-sdatac.title: Only SDATAC in RDATAC mode
rdatac-only-sdatac.quote: If the device is in RDATAC mode, a SDATAC command must be issued before any other commands can be sent to the device.

rdatac-keepout.title: RDATAC away from DRDY
rdatac-keepout.quote: There is a keep out zone of 4 tCLK cycles around the DRDY pulse where this command cannot be issued in.

read-before-next.title: Read done before the next DRDY
read-before-next.quote: DRDY is an output signal which transitions from high to low indicating new conversion data are ready.

sequences.title: Bring-up
sequences.summary: Power on, then the Brain Pong firmware's setup(), step by step.

steps.title: Power on
steps.text: The regulators bring up AVDD (5 V) and DVDD (3.3 V). PWDN and RESET stay low, so the chip stays off.
steps.quote: Before device power up, all digital and analog inputs must be low. At the time of power up, keep all of these signals low until the power supplies have stabilized.
notes: Supplies on: AVDD 5 V, DVDD 3.3 V

steps.title: Firmware boots
steps.text: The ESP32 boots, sets its pins as outputs with CS high, and waits 2.5 s. The chip is still powered down.

steps.title: Hold PWDN and RESET low
steps.text: ADS1299_SETUP() holds both pins low for 100 ms.
steps.quote: When PWDN is pulled low, all on-chip circuitry is powered down.

steps.title: Release PWDN and RESET
steps.text: Both pins go high together. The chip powers up, and VCAP1 starts to charge through its 100 µF capacitor. The firmware waits 1 s.
steps.quote: Wait for time tPOR, then transmit a reset pulse using either the RESET pin or RESET command to initialize the digital portion of the chip. Issue the reset after tPOR or after the VCAP1 voltage is greater than 1.1 V, whichever time is longer.
notes: Chip powers up: oscillator, bandgap, and VCAP1 start
Reset done: registers at defaults, RDATAC mode

checks.detail: RESET pin released 0.15 µs after power-up (needs ≥ 128.0 ms); VCAP1 = 0.00 V (needs ≥ 1.1 V)

steps.title: SDATAC (11h)
steps.text: One byte on the bus takes the chip out of continuous-read mode, so registers can be written.
steps.quote: Device Wakes Up in RDATAC Mode, so Send SDATAC Command so Registers can be Written

checks.detail: CS high for 3.60 s (needs ≥ 0.98 µs)
1.73 µs from the last SCLK falling edge to CS high (needs ≥ 1.95 µs)

steps.title: WREG CONFIG3 ← ECh
steps.text: Three bytes: write register 03h. ECh turns on the internal reference buffer and the bias drive.
steps.quote: If Using Internal Reference, Send This Command: WREG CONFIG3 E0h
notes: Reference buffer on: VREFP charges toward 4.5 V
Bias drive on: BIASOUT drives the body to mid-supply (2.50 V)

checks.detail: CS high for 10.15 µs (needs ≥ 0.98 µs)
2.60 µs between byte ends (needs ≥ 1.95 µs)
1.73 µs from the last SCLK falling edge to CS high (needs ≥ 1.95 µs)

steps.title: Reference and bias drive start
steps.text: VREFP starts to charge toward 4.5 V. BIASOUT drives the body to 2.5 V, and most of the mains hum on the electrodes goes away. The firmware waits 10 ms.
steps.quote: Internal reference start-up time: 150 ms (typical).

steps.title: Write 21 registers
steps.text: One WREG per register: 250 SPS, gain 24 on CH1 and CH2, CH3–CH8 off, SRB1 as the reference. CONFIG1 turns on the CLK output.
steps.quote: Write Certain Registers, Including Input Short

steps.title: Read the registers back
steps.text: RREG reads each register on DOUT. The firmware's loop skips CH1SET and MISC1.
steps.quote: RREG: Read n nnnn registers starting at address r rrrr

steps.title: START pin high
steps.text: Conversions start. The digital filter needs 32,777 clock cycles (16 ms) before the first result.
steps.quote: Activate Conversion. Set START = 1. After This Point DRDY Toggles at fCLK / 8192
notes: Conversions start; first data after tSETTLE = 16.0 ms

steps.title: START command (08h)
steps.text: The firmware also sends the START command. The START pin is already high, so it does nothing.
steps.quote: Tie the START pin low to control conversions by command. If conversions are in progress, this command has no effect.

steps.text: The firmware waits 20 ms. DRDY falls when each result is ready, every 4 ms. Nobody reads them yet.

notes: First data ready (16.0 ms after START)

steps.title: RDATAC (10h)

steps.quote: Put the Device Back in RDATAC Mode

sequences.title: Steady state
sequences.summary: Streaming at 250 samples per second while the player looks left and right.

steps.text: DRDY falls, the ESP32 pulls CS low and clocks out one frame, then waits for the next DRDY.

steps.title: One frame, bit by bit
steps.text: The first 48 of the frame's 216 bits: the 24 status bits, then CH1, MSB first. CH2 to CH8 follow the same way.
steps.quote: For the 8-channel ADS1299, the number of data outputs is [(24 status bits + 24 bits × 8 channels) = 216 bits]. The format of the 24 status bits is: (1100 + LOFF_STATP + LOFF_STATN + bits[4:7] of the GPIO register).

steps.title: Eye movements
steps.text: Looking left and right moves CH1 and CH2 in opposite directions. Brain Pong turns this into paddle position.
steps.quote: The device provides 24 bits of data in binary twos complement format.

sequences.title: Shutdown
sequences.summary: A clean shutdown with the datasheet's commands. The Brain Pong firmware has none: it loses power when unplugged.

steps.title: SDATAC (11h)
steps.text: Leave continuous-read mode first. In RDATAC mode the chip ignores every other command.
steps.quote: If the device is in RDATAC mode, a SDATAC command must be issued before any other commands can be sent to the device.

checks.detail: CS high for 1.9 ms (needs ≥ 0.98 µs)
1.72 µs from the last SCLK falling edge to CS high (needs ≥ 1.95 µs)

steps.title: STOP (0Ah)
steps.text: Stop conversions. The one in progress still finishes.
steps.quote: When the STOP command is sent, the conversion in progress completes and further conversions are stopped.

checks.detail: CS high for 10.15 µs (needs ≥ 0.98 µs)
1.72 µs from the last SCLK falling edge to CS high (needs ≥ 1.95 µs)

steps.title: Last result
steps.text: DRDY falls one more time. Nobody reads it, and no new result follows.
steps.quote: When the STOP command is sent, the conversion in progress completes and further conversions are stopped.

steps.title: STANDBY (04h)
steps.text: Low-power standby: everything off except the reference.
steps.quote: The STANDBY command enters low-power standby mode. All parts of the circuit are shut down except for the reference section.
notes: Bias drive off: the body floats again
Standby: all circuits off except the reference

checks.detail: CS high for 6.0 ms (needs ≥ 0.98 µs)
1.72 µs from the last SCLK falling edge to CS high (needs ≥ 1.95 µs)

steps.title: Bias drive off
steps.text: BIASOUT stops driving, the body floats, and mains hum comes back on the electrodes. VREFP holds.
steps.quote: All parts of the circuit are shut down except for the reference section.

steps.title: PWDN low
steps.text: Full power-down. VREFP and VCAP1 discharge through the chip's resistor network.
steps.quote: When PWDN is pulled low, all on-chip circuitry is powered down.
notes: Chip powered down: all circuits off; VCAP1 and VREFP discharge

steps.title: Supplies off
steps.text: AVDD and DVDD fall. The ESP32 loses power too, so every line goes low.
steps.quote: Before device power up, all digital and analog inputs must be low.
